D: A stranded couple find shelter in a castle run by a flamboyant mad scientist from outer space.
P: Serve the toast when Frank proposes one at dinner.
S: Fried custard bread fingers rolled in cinnamon sugar, maple syrup to dip

Thick white bread soaked in vanilla custard, fried golden in butter, cut into soldiers and rolled in cinnamon sugar, with maple syrup to dip. Whisk 3 eggs with 200ml milk, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt. Cut 6 thick slices white bread into 3 fingers each. Soak each finger for 10 seconds and fry in batches in 40g butter over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden. Roll straight away in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve with 125ml warm maple syrup for dipping.
Mini hot dogs simmered in a sweet tomato and mustard glaze
Cocktail frankfurts simmered in a sticky glaze of tomato sauce, brown sugar and mustard, served on toothpicks.
the Transylvanian party in the castle

Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, chilli, fennel seeds and garlic, with crusty bread to mop up the oil. Toast 1 tsp fennel seeds in a dry pan for 1 minute. Add 100ml olive oil, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 4 strips orange peel and half a tsp chilli flakes and warm gently for 4 minutes. Add 400g mixed green and black olives and heat through for 5 minutes, stirring. Rest 10 minutes so the flavours soak in. Serve warm with a sliced crusty baguette.
M: Beef and pork meatloaf with a tomato and brown sugar glaze
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs soaked in milk, onion, egg and Worcestershire, shaped in a loaf tin, glazed with tomato and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour.

Dry-brined roast chicken with crisp skin, garlicky roast potatoes, honey carrots and pan gravy, carved at the head of a long candlelit table. Salt a 1.8kg chicken and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until the thigh hits 75C, and rest. Parboil 1kg potatoes 8 minutes, toss with oil and 4 garlic cloves and roast at 220C for 45 minutes. Roast 500g carrots with 1 tbsp honey. Make gravy with the juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Two-layer butter cake with whipped cream filling, buttercream and edible gold
Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C for 25 minutes, cooled, split and layered with strawberry jam and whipped cream, covered in vanilla buttercream brushed with edible gold, candles in.
K: Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime with a flamed orange peel

Vodka shaken hard with orange liqueur, cranberry and fresh lime, strained into chilled coupes with a flamed orange twist. Chill 4 coupes. For each drink, shake 40ml vodka, 15ml orange liqueur, 30ml cranberry juice and 15ml lime juice with plenty of ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupes. Hold a strip of orange peel over each glass, warm it with a match and squeeze so the oil flashes, then drop it in. Totals are 160ml vodka and 60ml orange liqueur.
